title: Simone's belief that AI is the current revelation

tellings.quote: Simone's in in the book I have a chapter devoted to her she does believe that we're living in a time of a revelation literally though and what is being revealed is that we is AI

plain: A woman called Simone believes we are living, quite literally, in a time of revelation, and that what is being revealed is artificial intelligence. Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and UFO belief, describes her this way and says she gives Simone a whole chapter in her book Encounters.
